title: Delhi NCR - MPD-2021 and DDA Building Bye-laws 2016 (seed)

review.notes: SEED PACK - NOT AUTHORITATIVE. Table structure follows the published bye-laws; the numbers are plausible drafting defaults entered by the Garh AI team from secondary summaries, not transcribed from the primary document. An empanelled local architect must replace every value, confirm every citation, and move the pack to 'reviewed' before it is used on a submission.

disclaimer: Advisory only, not an approval. Every value in this pack is marked 'seed': it was drafted by the Garh AI team from secondary summaries of the bye-laws and has NOT been verified against the primary document or by a local architect. Do not rely on it for a sanction submission. The architect of record remains responsible for compliance; verify each figure against the current bye-laws and any local amendment before signing a drawing.
notes: Delhi indexes FAR and coverage on PLOT SIZE (not road width) and caps residential height flat at 15 m, so this pack has no road-width FAR/height families - only two road-width front-setback rules for wide roads. Plots up to 100 m2 in an approved layout may have NIL setbacks; that is encoded as the ABSENCE of setback rules for that band, never as a 0 mm rule, because a 0 mm minimum can never be violated and would give a false sense of having been checked. MPD-2021 also caps dwelling units per plot; there is no check type for that in schemaVersion 1 and it is deliberately omitted rather than approximated.

rules.title: Rainwater harvesting - required
rules.message: Rainwater harvesting is mandatory for plots of 100 m2 and above, and none is declared yet.
rules.fix: Add a rainwater harvesting sump or recharge pit to the site plan and tick the declaration in the regulatory profile.
rules.notes: Declaration check, not a geometric one: the MVP model has no RWH element, so the pack must not claim to verify capacity. Severity is warn for that reason.
